text:
All panelists unanimously agree on the figures drawn from the evidence packet. The scheduled end-to-end travel time between Orrinford Junction and Tarnside Park is 23 minutes, and trains will run every 6 minutes at peak.

Answer: 23 minutes end-to-end; every 6 minutes at peak.

Dredging will deepen the berth pocket to 17.8 metres, and after the expansion the terminal's annual capacity will be 2.1 million TEU.

Answer: 17.8 metres; 2.1 million TEU.

All panelists agree that the three-phase expansion programme lays 12.4 km (Phase 1), 8.7 km (Phase 2), and 15.6 km (Phase 3) of new pipe, totalling 36.7 km.

Answer: 36.7 kilometres

The original public opening was set for 14 September 2026. An 11-week (77-day) delay was announced in June 2026. Adding 77 days to 14 September 2026 yields 30 November 2026.

Answer: 30 November 2026

All panelists agree that mean systolic blood pressure fell by 13.6 mmHg in the tirnapexil arm at week 16, and that 19 tirnapexil participants experienced hyperkalaemia.

Answer: Mean systolic blood pressure fell by 13.6 mmHg, and 19 tirnapexil participants had hyperkalaemia.

All panelists agree that FVC declined by 171 mL over 52 weeks in the placebo group, and the most common adverse event was diarrhoea (reported in 22% of olvemarin participants).

Answer: FVC declined by 171 mL over 52 weeks in the placebo group; the most common adverse event was diarrhoea.

In the senotrazide arm, 450 participants received the drug (E2), and 54 discontinued before day 3 (E3). The percentage is (54 ÷ 450) × 100 = 12%.

Answer: 12%

Of the 312 participants randomized to the pelvastrin arm, 27 withdrew consent, 14 were lost to follow-up, and 19 died before month 24, totaling 60 non-completers. All remaining participants completed the 24-month follow-up. Therefore, 312 − 60 = 252 completed.

Answer: 252

All panelists unanimously agree on both figures, supported by evidence E5 and E6. The one outlier citing $438 million was identified as a transcription error contradicted by the same evidence source.

Answer: Corvane Logistics' year-end order backlog was $386 million, and it guided fiscal 2026 revenue growth of 6% to 8%.

Ostrel Savings Bank's CET1 ratio at year end was 14.3%, and its net interest margin for 2025 was 2.17%.

Answer: CET1 ratio 14.3%; net interest margin 2.17%.

Brightfen Foods' net sales grew from $250 million in fiscal 2024 to $295 million in fiscal 2025, an increase of $45 million. The percentage growth is calculated as (295 − 250) / 250 × 100 = 18%.

Answer: 18%

Tamberlin Software defines free cash flow as operating cash flow minus capital expenditures. For fiscal 2025, operating cash flow was $87.3 million and capital expenditures were $52.9 million, yielding free cash flow of $34.4 million.

Answer: $34.4 million

The jury awarded $1.64 million in compensatory damages and declined to award punitive damages.

Answer: The jury awarded $1.64 million in compensatory damages and did not award punitive damages.

The panel unanimously agrees on both figures based on the evidence packet. The contractual cap on Solgrave's total liability was 7.5 million euros (E4), and the tribunal awarded Ventrica 6.9 million euros (E7).

Answer: The contractual cap was 7.5 million euros, and the tribunal awarded Ventrica 6.9 million euros.

The effective date is 18 February 2025 (E2). Payment is due no later than 45 calendar days after that date, with 19 February counting as day 1 (E3). Counting forward: 10 days in February (19–28), 31 days in March (total 41), and 4 days into April reaches day 45 on 4 April 2025.

Answer: 4 April 2025

The panel unanimously concludes the defendant must pay $2.35 million in compensatory damages, $0.41 million in prejudgment interest, and $0.12 million in taxable costs, totaling $2.88 million. Legal fees are excluded as non-recoverable.

Answer: $2.88 million

All panelists agree that the tephra layer was dated to 4,270 years before present and found at a depth of 3.8 metres, as stated in evidence E4.

Answer: The tephra layer was dated to 4,270 years before present and found at a depth of 3.8 metres.

All panelists unanimously agree on the same values drawn from evidence E2 and E4.

Answer: LXP-9 had a room-temperature ionic conductivity of 0.84 mS/cm, and test cells retained 88% of their initial capacity after 500 cycles.

The terminus retreated 384 metres between the 2008 and 2024 surveys, a span of 16 years. Dividing 384 m by 16 years gives an average retreat rate of 24 metres per year.

Answer: 24 metres per year

The number of breeding pairs declined from 1,480 in 2015 to 1,110 in 2025, a drop of 370 pairs. The percentage decline is (370 / 1,480) × 100 = 25%.

Answer: 25%

All panelists unanimously agree on the same figures, supported by evidence E3 and E2.

Answer: 48,600 patients' records were exposed, and the attacker first gained access on 29 July 2025.

All panelists agree that an estimated 340 kilograms of ammonia was released before the line was isolated, and 3 workers were admitted to hospital overnight.

Answer: 340 kilograms of ammonia was released, and 3 workers were admitted to hospital overnight.

The panel unanimously agrees that the outage lasted from the first errors at 22:47 UTC on 9 October (E1) to the recorded end at 03:12 UTC on 10 October (E5), a duration of 4 hours and 25 minutes.

Answer: 4 hours and 25 minutes.

The incident lasted 35 minutes with 1,200 checkout attempts per minute, yielding 42,000 total attempts. At a 30% failure rate, the number of failed attempts is 12,600.

Answer: 12,600
